name: Istio
description:
Istio reduces the complexity of managing Kubernetes deployments by providing a uniform platform for securing, connecting, and monitoring microservices. 
The Sumo Logic App for Istio  provides visibility into the health and performance of Istio and its control plane components, including Mixer, Galley, Citadel, Pilot and Envoy. App dashboards also allow you to monitor how services and applications are performing in Istio Mesh, providing insights into service latency, errors, network traffic, and request workloads.

children.description: This dashboard helps you quickly analyze your error logs , log by components, and unsuccessful requests across all clusters.
children.title: Istio - Logs

queries.queryString:
namespace=istio-system cluster={{cluster}}
| timeslice 5m
| pod_labels_app as component
| count by component, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column component

namespace=istio-system cluster={{cluster}}
| if (pod_labels_app matches "*telemetry*" or pod_labels_app matches "*policy*", "Mixer",pod_labels_app) as component
| count by component 
| sort - _count

namespace=istio-system cluster={{cluster}}
| json field=_raw "log" as log_message
| parse regex field=log_message "\[(?<start_time>.+)\] \"(?<req>.+?)\" (?<response_code>.+?) (?<response_flags>.+?) (?<response_code_details>.+?) panels.title: Outlier Analysis
panels.text:
Use the following filters to calibrate and adjust outlier detection based on your needs : 

1. **window** is the time window used to calculate the moving average and standard deviation of the time series. Default: 1h

2. **threshold** is the number of standard deviations from the moving average that defines the threshold band. Default: 4
